en.hubeali:
Sa’d Bin Abdullah and Al Himeyri, altogether from Ibrahim Bin Mahziyar, from his brother Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali Al-Baqir<sup>asws</sup> passed away and he<sup>asws</sup> was fifty seven years old, during the year one hundred and twenty four. He<sup>asws</sup> lived after Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> for nineteen years and two months’.
